what: phao bơi, the inflatable swim ring of the people who swim at Bãi Trước
uses: Plan 0026, R10: a swimmer in the water holds one or sits in one; children wear one. Where they are rented in 2019 is Q3 (Check).

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: The south part of the beach full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: the low wall with balusters in sections on the sloped stone sea wall, a stair down to the sand in a gap between two sections, swim rings, light blue lamp poles behind the palms.

photos.date: 2019-04-30 (in the file name of the photo)
photos.author: Tuổi Trẻ
photos.shows: The beach of Bãi Trước full of people at the end of the afternoon, to the south: people on the sand and in the water, swim rings, a light blue lamp pole, Khách sạn Bưu điện, the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu, the stepped block, the orange tile roof, the hill Núi Nhỏ.

photos.author: Flickr user 110569822@N04
photos.shows: The north part of Bãi Trước from the beach, to the north (Núi Lớn with the cable car): the low wall of granite blocks with square posts and openings on the right, a flight of three or four steps down to the sand at the end of a section, a wider stair farther along, swim rings, people on the sand.

checks: A ring of 0.7 m ± 0.08 m outside with a tube of 0.2 m; shiny plastic of one strong color.

envelope.height.how: Photo 0: the tube is about 0.3 of the ring across.

parts.ring.at.how: The base point of the model.

parts.ring.color.how: Photo 0: yellow, orange, and pink rings; photo 2 (2019): piles of orange and yellow rings by the steps. The color is one of these for each ring.
